from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial line item (e.g., 收到其他与经营活动有关的现金)")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric extracted from the document")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period covered by the document")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt showing the metric and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_metrics: list[CompanyCashMetric]
